text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Finance Companies (Licensing Fees) Regulations. Licensing fees

(1) The following fees sl~all be charged in respect of a licence issued to a finance company -

(a) for a head office of a finance company, an annual fee of $30.000; [S 12/2006] tb) for a branch office of a finance company, an annual fee of $5.000.

(2) The manner in which such fees shall be levied sl~all be detennined by the Minister. B.L.R.O. 6.2021
